request: Design an acquiring strategy for a global e-commerce merchant.
selection_rationale: Acquiring footprint, market/channel acceptance and contracting responsibility are merchant acceptance strategy. Provider diligence and entity/activity applicability support separately scoped decisions.
practitioner_judgment: Appropriate bounded merchant acceptance lead; missing jurisdiction is now explicit. Global country coverage remains unresolved.
input_selection_caveat: The input tagged card as an acquiring-context assumption. The original request also permits noncard local methods; it must not narrow the downstream strategy to cards. No geographic scope was inferred.
